name: CLI Diagnostic Depth
statement: A developer runs cognitive health diagnostics and bulk-queries multiple subjects to assess knowledge quality and identify gaps — from the terminal using documented CLI commands.
successCriteria: limen health cognitive returns JSON cognitive health report with freshness distribution, conflicts, confidence stats, knowledge gaps, and stale domains
limen health cognitive --gapThresholdDays 7 overrides the gap detection threshold
limen recall-bulk --subjects '["entity:project:alpha","entity:project:beta"]' returns JSON array of result sets, one per subject
limen recall-bulk with --predicate and --minConfidence filters applies filters to all subjects
All stdout is valid JSON, all errors go to stderr as JSON
failureCriteria: limen health cognitive crashes on empty knowledge base instead of returning valid JSON
limen recall-bulk without --subjects produces non-JSON error
limen recall-bulk with invalid JSON in --subjects crashes instead of returning JSON error
Any command outputs non-JSON to stdout
preconditions: limen init completed (~/.limen/ exists with master key and config)
